issues.description: WHERE clause comparing Gemeinde.name to a numeric literal: solution_repository/aufgabe09.sql uses "Gemeinde.name = 12345" (numeric literal), while the problem statement requests zoos in a municipality named "Erlangen" (a string). This mismatch between a string-valued column (Gemeinde.name) and a numeric literal will produce no matches or incorrect results and contradicts the task description, confusing students about the expected filter.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the WHERE condition to compare the name as a string literal that matches the problem statement, e.g. replace "AND Gemeinde.name = 12345" with "AND Gemeinde.name = 'Erlangen'" (ensure single quotes around the string).
